**What you'll do**

1. Read what the TB-303 is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **TB-303 Bass Line** was made by **Roland** and released in **1981** (Wikipedia, "Roland TB-303").
- It was meant to play bass lines for guitarists practising alone. It sold badly at first.
- But it "became a foundation of electronic dance music genres such as acid house" (Wikipedia).
- It has a built-in **sequencer** too: see [Meet the TB-303 pattern mode](intro-tb-303-seq.qmd).

## Its sound

- **One oscillator**, sawtooth or square: a switch picks (TB-303 manual, p. 34).
- **Six knobs**: Cut off freq, Resonance, Env mod, Decay, Accent and Tuning (manual, p. 34).
- **Accent** and **slide** are stored on each step of a pattern (manual, p. 89).
- Its filter is 24 dB per octave and does not whistle by itself (Wikipedia).

## The panel

This is the TB-303 panel from [Classic Synths Compared](synth-compare.qmd), drawn after the real one (not a copy). Play it from the keys under the panel, the computer keys (a w s e d f t g y h u j k) or a MIDI keyboard. Turn any knob while you play. The sound is this site's own model; nobody has compared it with the real instrument.

## Guided tour

Every step plays the same acid line. Only the knobs change, one at a time.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-acid" data-set="{&quot;cutoff&quot;:6,&quot;res&quot;:0,&quot;envMod&quot;:0,&quot;accent&quot;:0,&quot;decay&quot;:4}"><p><b>Plain.</b> Resonance, Env mod and Accent at 0. Listen: a plain buzzy saw bass.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-acid" data-set="{&quot;cutoff&quot;:2,&quot;res&quot;:0,&quot;envMod&quot;:0,&quot;accent&quot;:0}"><p><b>Cut off freq down.</b> Turn the <b>Cut off freq</b> to 2. Listen: darker and softer.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-acid" data-set="{&quot;cutoff&quot;:2,&quot;res&quot;:8,&quot;envMod&quot;:0,&quot;accent&quot;:0}"><p><b>Resonance up.</b> Turn <b>Resonance</b> to 8. Listen for a ringing, nasal tone.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-acid" data-set="{&quot;cutoff&quot;:2,&quot;res&quot;:8,&quot;envMod&quot;:8,&quot;accent&quot;:0,&quot;decay&quot;:3}"><p><b>Env mod up.</b> Turn <b>Env mod</b> to 8. Listen: each note now starts bright and closes quickly: the "squelch".</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-acid" data-set="{&quot;cutoff&quot;:2,&quot;res&quot;:8,&quot;envMod&quot;:8,&quot;accent&quot;:0,&quot;decay&quot;:8}"><p><b>Decay longer.</b> Turn <b>Decay</b> to 8. Listen: each note stays bright for longer.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-acid"><p><b>Accent.</b> The example's own settings with <b>Accent</b> at 8. Listen for the accented notes jumping out, and the slides gliding.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="303-square"><p><b>Square wave.</b> Flip the waveform switch to square. Listen: hollower and softer.</p></div>
```

## Famous records

Named in Wikipedia, "Roland TB-303":

- Charanjit Singh, *Synthesizing: Ten Ragas to a Disco Beat* (1982)
- Orange Juice, "Rip It Up" (1983)
- Phuture, "Acid Tracks" (1987)

## Check yourself

Click an answer. You will see at once if it is right. Nothing is saved or sent.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-q" data-a="1"><p><b>Which knob makes each note start bright and close quickly?</b></p><ul><li>Tuning</li><li>Env mod</li><li>Volume</li><li>Accent</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Env mod sends the envelope to the filter.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>What two things are stored on a step besides pitch?</b></p><ul><li>Accent and slide</li><li>Reverb and delay</li><li>Chords and lyrics</li><li>Drums and bass</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 89.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="1"><p><b>How many waveforms does it have?</b></p><ul><li>One</li><li>Two: saw and square</li><li>Four</li><li>Sixty-four</li></ul><p class="ik-why">A switch picks saw or square.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>Which music grew up around the TB-303?</b></p><ul><li>Acid house</li><li>Baroque opera</li><li>Bluegrass</li><li>Barbershop</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Wikipedia.</p></div>
```
